title: GTA 6's PS5 Physical Edition Revealed in First Photo

Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 Grand Theft Auto GTA GTA 6's PS5 Physical Edition Revealed in First Photo Code-in-box by Sammy Barker 5 hours ago Share: Image: Push Square Images of GTA 6’s physical edition have emerged on Reddit , ahead of its release later in the month. The anticipated open world game – which won’t include a disc – looks practically identical to every other PS5 release, in a sealed blue plastic case with the usual logos and layout. While this is a German copy, there’s a disclaimer on the front which mentions no disc is included, and only a download code is packaged inside. The photos, first shared on Reddit but since deleted, have been reposted below: GTA 6’s code in box physical edition has been revealed. pic.twitter.com/aXof4DtJ3u - T5G (@Top5Gamingx) November 7, 2026 Fans will be able to purchase boxed versions of the Rockstar release from retailers starting 12th November, allowing a week for them to pre-load the 212GB title ahead of launch . This is the first major title to ship in a “code-in-box” format, although it will become a lot more common in 2028, when Sony’s signalled its intent to cease manufacturing Blu-ray discs . Personally, I’m concerned about the waste of plastic here. I understand some people may still want a case to display with their other games, but if we’re getting rid of discs, I’d like Sony to implement some sort of recyclable format moving forward. Remember, if you want a map of Leonidas to go with your physical copy of GTA 6, you’ll need to purchase that separately for $0.99 from the Rockstar Store. You can find out more information about GTA 6’s pre-load through here . In the meantime, do let me know if any of you are planning to purchase the physical version and why below.
